intro: Call of Earth is an introductory summons calling an initiate to attune with the spirits of the stone. Directed to Coldridge Valley, the traveler must seek out Teo Hammerstorm within the dwarven holdfast of Anvilmar.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It's past time ye heeded the earth, brave adventurer. The elements already prickle in yer skin, but once ye speak with the stone, the ground itself'll set firm 'neath yer soles--and in yer soul.
Seek out Teo Hammerstorm, in Coldridge Valley. Ye'll find him within Anvilmar, a holdfast forged by hammer, fire, and will.
